purpose: Close only the remaining object-to-summary gap after the nineteen-host, ellipse, and summary-covariance layers have been reproduced.

identityCrosswalk.gate: Every reported count is an executable projection of the same 154-row ledger.

geometricSelection.gate: Coordinates alone reproduce 63 spiral, 55 tidal, 24 other labels including the two chord exclusions.

photometricTransformation.gate: Corrected published values are regenerated from raw columns without inferred constants.

fitReceipt.gate: A reference build and an independent build reproduce every value within 0.001 mag.

prospectiveCrossover.hypothesis: If the single-epoch phase algorithm is unbiased across background regimes, its error relative to a two-epoch estimate has the same mean in the spiral and tidal components after period, color, and phase-ambiguity matching.
prospectiveCrossover.primaryAdjudicand: (single-epoch minus two-epoch mean)_tidal minus (single-epoch minus two-epoch mean)_spiral
prospectiveCrossover.minimumDesign: Predeclare balanced strata, seal validation identities, obtain a second F090W/F150W epoch, freeze the first-epoch algorithm before opening it, and use an independent reduction for the final contrast.
prospectiveCrossover.success: Absolute contrast below 0.01 mag with compatible independent reductions over the registered background range.
prospectiveCrossover.reject: A reproducible contrast at or above 0.01 mag that tracks first-epoch phase ambiguity after matching.
prospectiveCrossover.stop: Identity leakage, post-outcome strata changes, phase-dependent missingness, or reduction disagreement.
